ANALYZE :: POSITION PREVIEW

Enter an XGID to render the position on a clear backgammon board. You can also open or share a position using a direct link.

::: {.bms-analyze-status}
**PUBLIC PROTOTYPE**

The position preview is working. Engine analysis, candidate moves, move rankings, and position editing are not yet connected.
:::

## Position Preview

A sample XGID is loaded below. Replace it inside the application to preview another position.

::: {.bms-analyzer-frame}
```{=html}
<iframe
  src="https://backgammon-made-simple.shinyapps.io/position-dashboard/?position=XGID%3D-B-BBBF-------a----dccb-b-%3A1%3A-1%3A1%3A65%3A0%3A3%3A0%3A5%3A8"
  title="Backgammon Made Simple position preview"
  loading="eager"
></iframe>
